title: Evaluating the Robustness of Fact-Checking LLMs on Multilingual Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2611.18623v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated fact-checking benchmarks typically pair claims with clean, curated evidence in high-resource languages, but real-world evidence is often incomplete, misleading, or written in a language where models are weaker. We evaluate the robustness of fact-checking LLMs for different languages. Building on EuroVerdict, we construct gold evidence sets for 190 claims in each of English, German, Greek, and Romanian, then apply four corruption strategies at two severity levels. We test LLMs on a set of claims, providing them with evidence from the sets above. A rubric-based LLM-as-a-judge scores reasoning quality. Verdict accuracy proves highly sensitive to both factors: Misleading edit cut Llama 3.1 8B's English accuracy from 80.00% to 16.84%, and losses widen as language resource level decreases. Machine-translating Greek and Romanian claims into English recovers much, but not all, of the low-resource gap. Judge scores decline more slowly

translated_title: 评估事实核查大语言模型在多语言证据上的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 自动化事实核查基准通常将声明与高资源语言中干净、经过精心整理的证据配对，但现实世界中的证据往往不完整、具有误导性，或以模型能力较弱的语言书写。我们评估了事实核查大语言模型在不同语言下的鲁棒性。基于EuroVerdict，我们为英语、德语、希腊语和罗马尼亚语各190条声明构建了黄金证据集，然后在两个严重程度级别上应用四种证据破坏策略。我们在一组声明上测试大语言模型，为其提供来自上述证据集的证据，并采用基于评分标准的“大语言模型作为评委”方法对推理质量进行评分。结果显示判定准确性对这两个因素都高度敏感：误导性编辑使Llama 3.1 8B的英语准确率从80.00%降至16.84%，且随着语言资源水平的降低，性能损失进一步扩大。将希腊语和罗马尼亚语声明机器翻译成英语可以恢复大部分（但非全部）低资源差距，而评委评分的下降速度相对较慢。
tldr: 该研究通过构建多语言黄金证据集并系统性地应用四种证据破坏策略，首次评估了事实核查大语言模型在多语言环境下的鲁棒性，发现判定准确性对证据误导性和语言资源水平均高度敏感。
en_tdlr: This study is the first to evaluate the robustness of fact-checking LLMs in multilingual settings by constructing gold evidence sets and systematically applying evidence corruption strategies, revealing that verdict accuracy is highly sensitive to both evidence misleadingness and language resource level.
